title: Design System: 免费 API 中文索引

motion.name: state-shift
motion.purpose: Entry hover and state transitions only.

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Rectangular status marker used in the ledger and specification grid.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 7px; border: 1px solid #dcb463; border-radius: 2px; color: #dcb463; background: transparent; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1.55; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Seal Button
components.description: Thin cinnabar outlined action for CSV export and secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-seal-button { padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid #e3694a; border-radius: 2px; color: #e3694a; background: transparent; font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seal-button:hover { color: #090c0a; background: #e3694a; } .ds-seal-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3694a; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A Chinese lexicon read after hours: warm bone type on ink, cinnabar marks for action, and a ruled index that behaves like a working tool. The metaphor enters through type, palette, density, and the category-code rail, never through terminal costume or card decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm bone serif against ink with cinnabar used for state and action.
Flat, ruled composition with no cards, pills, gradients, or shadows.
Dense entries that prioritize name, definition, quota, authentication, and status.

rules.name: The Cinnabar Rarity Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar marks action, selection, and the index. It is never a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Text-First Status Rule
rules.body: Every status stamp carries text; color is a second signal.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Repeated content is a ruled ledger. Cards are not part of this system.

dos: Use the serif for API names and page headings.
Keep the ledger readable with JavaScript disabled.
Let hairlines and spacing carry hierarchy.
donts: Don't introduce pill-shaped badges or floating cards.
Don't use mono for ordinary prose.
Don't let the lexicon metaphor replace standard web controls.
